name: tawsel
description: Tawsel delivery application workspace around the retained routing Engine

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && npm run build -w @tawsel/api && npm run build -w @tawsel/web
scripts.check: npm run audit && npm run lint && npm run contracts:lint && npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ci && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors green,blue "npm run dev -w @tawsel/api" "npm run dev -w @tawsel/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/api && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/web && npm run typecheck -w @tawsel/api-client && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test:fast: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && vitest run --project fast
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration
scripts.test:ci: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.test:database: npm run build -w @tawsel/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.database.local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --project integration apps/api/test/integration/database-lifecycle.test.ts apps/api/test/integration/command-transaction.test.ts
